output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It does not check if the total supply overflows, allowing the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value.
The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It does not check if the balance of the recipient overflows, allowing attackers to steal funds from recipients.
The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It does not check if the balance of the recipient overflows, allowing attackers to steal funds from recipients.
The approve function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It does not check if the allowance overflows, allowing attackers to steal funds from users.
The burn function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It does not check if the balance of the owner overflows, allowing attackers to steal funds from users.
